svg.title: ISU Research Study E-Library - Data Model (Cloud Firestore + browser)

g.text: ISU Research Study E-Library - Data Model (Cloud Firestore + browser)
department : string (college full name, "" when unset)
department : string (holds the COLLEGE full name)
adviser : string (1-3 names joined by " and ")
driveLink : string (Google Drive link of the PDF)
updatedBy? : string (uid, only after an edit)
updatedAt? : Timestamp | string | null (only after an edit)
form : driveLink, title, department, year, adviser
tab or "edit:{id}" to reopen after a reload
create: own uid only AND role == 'STUDENT'
update: own uid only AND role unchanged (role locked)
Role STAFF and the college are set by the
Firebase administrator in the Firebase console
Created by getUserProfile() on the first
old status values read as POSTED, missing authors
as [], old department names as their college
Rebuilt from the theses loaded by subscribeToTheses();
nothing here is stored. The study PDF itself stays in
